text.card: A star about 120 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 10.9 solar radii and 1.36 solar masses (FLAME) and 4,574 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: HD 32518
quotes.card: HD 32518, also named Mago, is a star with an orbiting exoplanet in the northern circumpolar constellation Camelopardalis.
quotes.introduction: It has an apparent magnitude of 6.42, placing it near the limit of naked eye visibility.
